exposure: HIV viral load (≤1,000 copies/ml vs. unknown or >1,000 copies/ml)
outcome: Mode of delivery (vaginal, scheduled cesarean, emergent cesarean)
cohort: 824 deliveries from 648 HIV-infected pregnant women in Philadelphia from 2005 to 2013
finding: Only half of deliveries for women with an unknown HIV viral load or viral load >1,000 copies/ml occurred via scheduled cesarean delivery, indicating suboptimal adherence to guidelines.
mod_finding: Women delivering prior to 38 weeks gestation, particularly minority women, were less likely to have a scheduled cesarean delivery, representing a missed opportunity for intervention.
